entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, read 61 centimetres on 16 November, up from 59 centimetres on 15 November
entry.summary: The 06:15 reading is 2 centimetres above the day before, after a recovery from a 5 centimetre low on 8 November. Barges still load below capacity at this depth. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, Kaub readings of 15 and 16 November 2026
